title: Sgt. Verbeck’s Ego, Coffee Demands & Community Updates | Blue Notebook Review
description:
Big ego. Coffee requests. Real updates. ☕
Sgt. Verbeck introduces Santa Monica’s Neighborhood Resources Officers—straight from the field.
transcript_text: You get the parts that are shiny. >> Yeah. >> Okay. >> Can you hurry? We have to get started soon. Thank you. Then where's my coffee? >> It's right there. >> On my left side. You know I like on my right side. You always put on my left side and every week I tell you it's on the right side. You have a 50-50 chance of getting this right and you get it wrong every week and it's still burning. Good help is so hard to find. Hi, my name is Sergeant Rick with the San Police Department and this is your blue notebook review.
